hook_text: One cell, one bulb, some wires. Why can't half the class make it light?
clip_script: Middelburg, the bulb challenge. One wire: nothing. Both wires on the plus end: nothing. Plus, through the bulb, back to minus: it glows! The circuit must go all the way round. Then: find the fault. A clip on the plastic, a loose bulb, a blown filament, a flat cell. Last, a switch made of a paper clip and two pins. Closed: on. Open: off!
visual_style: Whiteboard loop that only lights up when the last wire joins, then a paper clip swinging to close and open a gap.
pacing: Failed tries, the success, fault-finding, then the homemade switch.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and look at how the switches in your home work.
